messages:
maria: heads up — we just got a support ticket: users logged out of our app but still show as active in the SCIM user list and several got duplicate accounts created on next sync. looks like it started after last night's idp config change.
chris: which idp change? saml or oidc? i saw a canary that touched NameID formatting earlier.
maria: OIDC provider updated front-channel logout URL + they switched subject claim from 'sub' to 'email' for a subset of clients. ticket says some providers now send a different sub format (email vs uuid).
raj: that explains duplicates — our SCIM linking uses externalId = idp.sub. if the sub value changed we create a new user record.
tegan: also seeing noise in audit logs — logout events appear but with no session id fields. wondering if our SLO (single logout) handler is swallowing session cookie metadata when front-channel redirects happen.
maria: exact logs from support:

```
INFO logout_received user=alice@example.com idp_sub=alice@example.com redirect=/sso/slo
WARN session_lookup failed missing_cookie
INFO scim_provision new_user created externalId=alice@example.com
```

maria: note earlier we used UUID subs: `externalId=91f3...` so they're now different.
chris: hmm — two problems: 1) idp changed subject claim => SCIM linking mismatch 2) SLO redirect lost cookie => audit trail incomplete. both worsen incident response.
raj: quick mitigation: update SCIM linking to try matching on email fallback if externalId lookup misses, but we need to log that fallback in audit.
tegan: can we patch to do a two-step reconciliation: try externalId, then look up by email and merge if unique? but that has race conditions during provisioning.
maria: agree. also we need to notify customers who use that identity provider about the change. but before that, we should prevent on-the-fly duplicate account creation.
ops-oncall: is there a way to short-circuit provisioning until we deploy fix? can toggle SCIM auto-provisioning per-tenant.
chris: yes we can flip a flag for the affected tenant(s). will need policy owners approval for mass toggles.
raj: temporary fix PR idea:

```
if not found_by_externalId:
  candidate = find_user_by_email(email)
  if candidate and candidate.idp_provider == incoming.provider:
    link_accounts(candidate, incoming)
  else:
    create_user()
```

raj: add an audit event tag `provision.fallback=email-match` when that path runs.
tegan: +1 but add throttles to avoid linking wrong accounts if there are multiple matches.
maria: also the SLO cookie loss — ops observed front-channel logout replacing the host header, causing our cookie domain check to fail.
chris: stack trace from auth-proxy attached:

```
ERROR cookie_validation host=frontend-idp.example.org expected=app.example.com
ERROR slo_handler missing_session_id
```

chris: fix could be to accept forwarded host header for SLO endpoints or to use id token hint to correlate session when cookie missing.
tegan: token-hint route seems safer than loosening host checks. we can tie logout to id_token_hint.sub and verify signature.
ops-oncall: pls coordinate with infra — signature verification will need access to idp jwks and cache; might hit KMS for key retrieval? we should avoid heavy KMS calls on the hot path.
maria: KMS note: when we re-encrypt session tokens after last KMS rotation some sessions failed to decrypt and ended up in 'orphaned' state. that contributed to session_lookup missing_cookie.
chris: timeline: KMS rotation at 02:12, sessions rekey job ran 02:15, idp change at 03:00. some rekey jobs logged:

```
WARN rekey failed session=abcd decrypt_err=invalid_nonce
WARN rekey retry count=3
INFO rekey skipped orphaned session=abcd
```

chris: we should run a targeted re-encrypt with robust retry and alert on orphaned > threshold.
raj: action items I can take now:
- PR for fallback email-linking + audit tag
- small throttle to avoid merges when multiple candidates
- add metric `provision.fallback.email` and alert on >10/min

tegan: i'll implement id_token_hint verification path for SLO; will use cached JWKS with 1h TTL, local mem cache to avoid KMS calls. will add audit events for 'slo.id_token_hint' vs 'slo.cookie'.
ops-oncall: i'll flip auto-provisioning off for impacted tenant while you ship the fallback. also opening a customer advisory draft.
maria: i'll coordinate comms and run a one-off user merge job for duplicates with ops and data-platform.
chris: QA: make sure test covers sub/email switch scenario and that fallback creates an audit entry linking accounts and who-approved.
devsec-bot: flagged high-priority incident INC-2026; suggested severity P2 because user accounts can be duplicated and audit trail is impacted.
maria: thanks all. let's circle in 30 for quick sync.
__notes: do not include a title field per agents.md
